summary: Enabled a persistent UFW host firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 24.04) with default-deny incoming, allowing only OpenSSH (22/tcp) and 8080/tcp; verified enforcement and persistence across a full node restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS and existing firewall state (ufw present but inactive)
Configured ufw: default deny incoming, default allow outgoing, allow OpenSSH, allow 8080/tcp
Enabled ufw (--force enable), confirmed 'enabled on system startup'
Verified iptables ufw-user-input chain only ACCEPTs tcp/22 and tcp/8080
Confirmed an unrelated port (2222) is rejected via nc probe
Restarted node1 via 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Confirmed boot_id changed (e8afb731... -> ccaef2cb...), proving an actual restart
Post-restart verified ufw is active/enabled with identical rules, SSH reachable, and unrelated port 2222 still rejected

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall configured: allow SSH + 8080/tcp, deny/reject other inbound
evidence.summary: Baseline showed ufw inactive with only sshd listening; configured default-deny-incoming ufw with allow rules for OpenSSH and 8080/tcp, enabled at boot; iptables ufw-user-input chain confirmed ACCEPT only for tcp/22 and tcp/8080; probe to unrelated port 2222 failed (rejected)

evidence.requirement: Firewall enabled for persistence (survives reboot) - systemd enablement check
evidence.summary: systemctl is-enabled ufw returned 'enabled', confirming boot-time persistence

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335) and confirmed ufw active with correct rules before reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via nohup; command returned 'reboot triggered' immediately

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection timed out) then reachable again with new boot_id ccaef2cb-5e96-4a46-8c48-6b733bcca129, differing from baseline, and new uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of firewall state and service health
evidence.summary: After reboot, ufw is active/enabled automatically with identical allow rules (22/tcp, 8080/tcp), sshd listening and reachable, and unrelated port 2222 still rejected, confirming persistence and correct enforcement post-restart
